routes.name: Visa-free entry
routes.summary: Most visitors enter without a visa for up to 1 month. CARICOM nationals and British passport holders get 6 months. OECS nationals have indefinite stay.

other: Need funds to support your stay
Two government pages list different visa-required countries, so check before you go

stay.note: 6 months for CARICOM and British passports. Indefinite for OECS.

routes.name: Entry visa
routes.summary: Citizens of a short list of countries need a visa, issued by the Ministry of National Security. The fee is EC$200. A sponsor in SVG is looked at closely.

other: Listed countries differ between the two official pages, so confirm yours
Proof of funds, job, accommodation, invitation letter from a sponsor and police record are checked
